description: Build Grandpa's jetpack at the shed for 40 Al and 15 Cu. The blueprint comes with clearing wave 9 (phase 3); hold Jump in the air.
+15% recharge speed per level. Level 4 also cuts the recharge delay by 0.25 s.
+8% jetpack climb rate and air speed per level.
Hold Jump while aiming to hover, burning fuel at 40%.
Press Shift or LB in the air to burst along your movement direction.
Press Ctrl or RB in the air to slam down and blast nearby robots on landing.
